title: Lemonade
text:
Today I will show you how to make lemonade. It is a cold drink, and it is good on a hot day. You need three lemons, one cup of sugar, and four cups of water. First, cut the lemons in half. Then squeeze the juice into a big bowl.

Next, add the sugar and the water to the bowl. Stir everything with a spoon until the sugar melts. Put the lemonade in the fridge for one hour. Then it is ready to drink.

questions.text: How many lemons do you need?
What do you do with the sugar and the water?
options: You add them to the bowl.
You cook them for an hour.

questions.text: Why is lemonade a good drink for a hot day?
Why do you put the lemonade in the fridge?
options: To make it cold for drinking.

vocabulary.definition: to press something to get the liquid out of it
to move a liquid around with a spoon
a machine in the kitchen that keeps food and drinks cold

paragraph_translations: Hoy les voy a enseñar cómo hacer limonada. Es una bebida fría y es buena en un día caluroso. Necesitas tres limones, una taza de azúcar y cuatro tazas de agua. Primero, corta los limones por la mitad. Luego, exprime el jugo en un tazón grande.
Después, añade el azúcar y el agua al tazón. Revuelve todo con una cuchara hasta que el azúcar se disuelva. Pon la limonada en el refrigerador durante una hora. Luego, ya está lista para beber.
